note: Illustrative native Figma fixtures only. No live database records or seeds.

rules.goalChronology: None: goal records have no minute or timestamp.
rules.grouping: Group by credited side and player. Normal entries with the same player aggregate count and assist identities; keep own goals separate and attach the opposing player roster tag. Never infer event time.
rules.assist: Optional linked nick on the corresponding normal goal; never on own goals.
rules.wo: 3–0 is this fixture's explicitly stored score, not a W.O. rule.
rules.live: Status illustration; no elapsed time or verified realtime transport.
rules.draw: 2–2 with scorer records unavailable; no invented advancement or penalties.
